Frame f4 captures a player in white executing a long-range shot towards the goal from outside the box, matching the description of an外围 (peripheral/long-range) shot.
Frame f6 shows a player in white kicking the ball from the corner arc into the penalty area, visually confirming the corner kick event.
Frame f9 depicts a player in red (Team 2) using their body to block a cross from a player in white (Team 1) near the goal line, supporting the defensive action annotation.
